Congress Seeks Report on Great Nicobar Project

The Congress party has urged the National Green Tribunal to make public a report on the Great Nicobar Project, which they claim is 'ecologically disastrous'. Jairam Ramesh stated that the NGT must release the report of the panel that reviewed approvals for the project. The party is seeking the release of the report to allegedly expose the 'big flaws' in the project. The Great Nicobar Project has been a subject of controversy, with the Congress party training its criticism on the NGT over the project's approvals. The NGT is expected to make a decision on the matter.
